title: ELCANO satellite payload integrates video, NIR, thermal imaging
text:
## 事件
- 西班牙卫星载荷公司Satlantis推出新一代FlexSat卫星平台ELCANO，集成了高分辨率成像、视频、近红外、热成像、偏振测量及太空态势感知等多种传感器。
- 该平台可在1分钟内成像长达400公里的非线性区域，声称相当于当前40颗卫星或40天运营才能完成的观测任务。

## 影响
- 多传感器融合单平台方案可能提升遥感任务的效率与实时性，降低对星座规模的依赖。
- 应用方向覆盖国防、边境监视、海事、应急响应及环境监测，军事与民用市场均有机会受益。
- 西班牙太空经济规模已位居欧洲第三，该技术或进一步强化其产业链地位。

## 标的线索
- 西班牙卫星载荷企业Satlantis（未上市，待核实）
- 卫星遥感、多光谱/热成像传感器相关板块（待核实）

## 待验证
- ELCANO平台的具体技术指标（如分辨率、轨道参数）及量产时间表。
- 与40颗卫星等效能力的具体对比依据和验证结果。
- “西班牙太空经济欧洲第三”的数据来源及统计口径。

prompt_system:
你是「资讯雷达」投研向改写助手。任务：把用户提供的一篇资讯压成可读的投研草稿。

硬性要求：
1. 严格用下面四个中文小节标题（Markdown ##），顺序固定，每节 1-4 条短句：
## 事件
## 影响
## 标的线索
## 待验证
2. 只客观陈述；不推荐买卖；不预测涨跌；不构成投资建议。
3. 「标的线索」只能写可能相关的公司/板块/主题，并标注「待核实」；没有则写「暂无明确标的线索」。
4. 「待验证」写需要交叉核对的事实或缺口；没有则写「暂无」。
5. 不要输出前后缀寒暄、不要编造文中不存在的数字。

The Earth Observation payload integrates multiple sensors and advanced capabilities into a single platform, said the company. ELCANO The technology can image up to 400 kilometres of non-linear territory in one minute. This enables missions equivalent to those that would currently require up to 40 satellites or 40 days of operations. The multi-payload architecture integrates high-resolution imaging, video, near-infrared (NIR), thermal imaging, polarimetry and Space Domain Awareness (SDA) capabilities. Specifically, its Satlantis iSIM-90 and iSIM-170 optical cameras and CASPER, the company’s thermal observation telescope. Applications include defence, border surveillance, maritime domain awareness, emergency response and environmental monitoring. Juan Tomás Hernani, the CEO of Satlantis said that “the company aims to combine a historical perspective with a vision of the present and the future.” He added that these the satellites “introduce a new technology and a new perspective from space,” enabling solutions to “real-world challenges faced by both citizens and the Armed Forces”. Global intelligence The name ELCANO comes from Juan Sebastián Elcano, the first to circumnavigate the globe, in 1519 to 1522, surviving the death of Ferdinand Magellan. “That same pioneering spirit now extends into space as the new frontier for observation, intelligence and knowledge,” says Satlantis. Spain now has the third largest space economy in Europe, employing 65,000 people, according to a new report. This is ahead of the UK with 55,000. The company headquarters are in Bilbao. And ELCANO is being developed at SATLANTIS facilities in Leioa and Astrabudua. See all our Space content .
